A Keybase team is a group of people who can communicate with end-to-end cryptography. This means the team's chats and files cannot be read by anyone outside the team, not even someone who breaks into Keybase's servers. Membership/role changes are entered into a chain of signatures which (1) cannot be altered by a malicious person outside the team, and (2) must be signed by a team admin, as defined by previous links in the chain.
